question:
Select the most appropriate homonym to fill in the blank.

During the _____ of Queen Victoria, England made all-round progress.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is '**reign**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**reign**" refers to the period during which a sovereign rules. (शासनकाल)
 
• Queen Victoria's reign marked a period of significant progress and prosperity in England.
 
• The other options, such as "**rain**" (precipitation), "**rein**" (a strap to guide a horse), and "**rhine**" (a river), do not fit the context of the sentence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *During the reign__ of Queen Victoria, England made all-round progress.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Rain (बारिश)**: Refers to water droplets falling from clouds.
 
• **Rein (लगाम)**: Refers to the leather strap used to control a horse.
 
• **Rhine (राइन)**: Refers to a major European river.

```
